newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Progressive to realign into two chains.
newsitem.headline: Progressive to realign into two chains.

text.p: Progressive Enterprises Ltd chief executive Graeme Kelly said on Thursday the company planned a major realignment of its business into two supermarket chains from the current three.

The move would leave Progressive with the Foodtown and Countdown chains and the 3 Guys brand would go, Kelly told Reuters. The estimated cost of the realignment would be NZ$50-80 million over four years.
Countdown would become a regional "superstore" and Foodtown would take on a neighbourhood focus.
